maria_support: Heads up — Acme just escalated a JSON-mode function/toolcall failure. They're getting a 422 `invalid_function_args` when calling the `create_order` tool. Customer says payload is valid JSON but runtime rejects it. Posting minimal repro + logs below.

maria_support: ```json
{
  \"order_id\": \"ACME-9987\",
  \"items\": \"[\"sku_123\", \"sku_456\"]\",  // array got stringified by their SDK
  \"shipping\": {
    \"address\": {
      \"line2\": \"Apt 5\"
      // line1 missing
    }
  }
}
```

jasper_se: Do we have the raw request headers and the runtime validation error? Also which SDK/version are they on?

maria_support: Headers they sent: `Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8`, `User-Agent: acme-checkout/1.4.2`
Logs from runtime: 
```
2026-03-17T09:12:01.234Z runtime.validate: validation failed for tool=create_order, request_id=rc_01e9, error=Missing required property 'shipping.address.line1' at /order/shipping/address
2026-03-17T09:12:01.234Z runtime.parse: type mismatch at /order/items, expected array, got string
```

kevin_infra: This matches an older SDK issue we saw where the SDK sent JSON as text/plain or form-encoded and our body parser fell back to a legacy path that coerces arrays into strings. Two immediate things: ensure `Content-Type: application/json` and ask them to upgrade SDK to 1.5.0 (fix pushed in 1.5.0 to set header correctly). Can repro locally with: 
```
curl -v -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/tools/create_order \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data-binary '{"order_id":"T1","items":["a","b"],"shipping":{"address":{"line1":"1 Main St"}}}'
```
If you call with `Content-Type: text/plain` our parser may treat body as string, then downstream validation fails.

jasper_se: Thanks — good catch. Can we add a short runtime guard to coerce `items` if it's a JSON-stringified array? That would reduce customer impact while customers upgrade. If not feasible quickly, we'll provide a step-by-step repro and workaround to Acme. I'll open an eng issue for a small tolerant validation shim.

maria_support: I'll send these repro steps to Acme now: 1) confirm `Content-Type: application/json` 2) upgrade to SDK >= 1.5.0 3) if they can't upgrade, send raw JSON via curl with `--data-binary` as above or un-stringify `items` before sending. I'll attach the runtime logs and ask for a sample request ID.

jasper_se: Please include `rc_01e9` and tag `eng-runtime`. I'll take the follow-up for a tolerant validation path.

alertbot: Incident created: INF-2026-3211 — Title: "toolcall: stringified-array + missing nested key causing validation 422 (Acme)" — Assigned: eng-runtime — Priority: P2

maria_support: Copy, updating ticket and notifying Acme. Will post back if they can repro after header/SDK change. :white_check_mark:
